FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios fr LEFT JOIN cf USING(subsidiary_id) LEFT JOIN ar USING(subsidiary_id) LEFT JOIN cp USING(subsidiary_id)), trends AS (SELECT *,overall_financial_health_score avg_financial_health,overall_financial_health_score*0 financial_health_volatility,net_profit_margin avg_net_margin,current_ratio avg_current_ratio,CASE WHEN 10 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN current_ratio<1 THEN 25 WHEN current_ratio<1.5 THEN 15 WHEN current_ratio<2 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END total_risk_score FROM trends) SELECT total_risk_score::INTEGER,CASE WHEN total_risk_score>=70 THEN 'Critical Risk' WHEN total_risk_score>=50 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN total_risk_score>=30 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END risk_level,CASE WHEN overall_financial_health_score<40 THEN 'Poor Financial Health' WHEN cash_flow_risk_level LIKE '%High Risk%' THEN 'Cash Flow Issues' WHEN overdue_percentage>.3 THEN 'High Receivables Risk' WHEN current_ratio<1 THEN 'Liquidity Concerns' ELSE 'No Major Risk Factors' END primary_risk_factor,CASE WHEN current_ratio>=2 THEN 'Above Target' WHEN current_ratio>=1.5 THEN 'At Target' ELSE 'Below Target' END liquidity_performance,CASE WHEN net_profit_margin>=.15 THEN 'Above Target' WHEN net_profit_margin>=.05 THEN 'At Target' ELSE 'Below Target' END profitability_performance,CASE WHEN return_on_equity>=.15 THEN 'Above Target' WHEN return_on_equity>=.1 THEN 'At Target' ELSE 'Below Target' END roe_performance,CASE WHEN overdue_percentage<=.05 THEN 'Above Target' WHEN overdue_percentage<=.15 THEN 'At Target' ELSE 'Below Target' END collection_performance,'Maintain Current Performance' improvement_recommendation,CASE WHEN overall_financial_health_score>=80 AND total_risk_score<30 THEN 'A+ Excellent' WHEN overall_financial_health_score>=70 AND total_risk_score<50 THEN 'A Good' WHEN overall_financial_health_score>=60 AND total_risk_score<70 THEN 'B Fair' WHEN overall_financial_health_score>=40 THEN 'C Poor' ELSE 'D Critical' END overall_rating,CASE WHEN total_risk_score>=70 THEN 'URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk
